claim: Let \(G\) be the graph with vertex set \(\{0,1,2,3,4,5\}\) and edge set \(\{01,12,23,30,04,45\}\), i.e. a four-cycle with a path of length two attached at vertex \(0\). Then the generalized Morse complex satisfies \(\mathcal{GM}(G)\simeq\bigvee^{2}S^{3}\), while the ordinary Morse complex satisfies \(\mathcal M(G)\simeq\bigvee^{4}S^{3}\). In particular, extending the single pendant edge by one further edge destroys the homotopy-type agreement between generalized and ordinary Morse complexes that holds for a cycle with a single leaf.

title: A two-edge tail separates generalized and ordinary Morse complexes of \(C_4\)
